tasks.label: Start server
tasks.detail: Frees port 8000, installs requirements, runs uvicorn with reload
tasks.command: command -v docker >/dev/null && docker compose down >/dev/null 2>&1; lsof -ti tcp:8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload

tasks.label: Stop server
tasks.command: lsof -ti tcp:8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Port 8000 is free.'
